title: Deliberate Wraparound
prompt: Implement `unsigned int fnv1a_step(unsigned int h, unsigned char byte)` — one FNV-1a round: h ^= byte; h *= 16777619u. Unsigned overflow is *defined* modular arithmetic; this hash depends on it. Then implement `int mod16(int x)` returning x mod 16 for non-negative x using only unsigned reasoning (no % on negative signed values).

tests.name: known FNV step
tests.hint: xor 0x61 into the offset basis, then multiply by 16777619 — defined modular 2^32.

tests.name: wrap is deterministic
tests.hint: 0xFFFFFFFF ^ 1 = 0xFFFFFFFE; times the prime mod 2^32 = 4261412058 — the same value every run, by definition.

tests.name: mod without %
tests.hint: x & 15 computes the same value as x % 16 for non-negative x.
